text:
serena: quick design QA — uploaded 'nocturne' palette to Figma. main asks: tiny legend dot halo, inline-code caret contrast, series separation for colorblind modes, and theme selector copy. figma: https://figma.com/file/nocturne (frames 2-4). please skim.

jay: spotted the dots disappearing at 200px. the 6px dot with no halo blends into #0b1016. propose a 1px white halo (rgba(255,255,255,0.06)) OR stroke 2px with slight offset. halo keeps original fill which i prefer.

mike: accessibility note: caret in inline code is #56dfff over code-bg #0c0f14 -> ~2.8 contrast. need >=4.5. suggest caret #aef6ff (est. 5.2) and inline-code font-weight 500 so punctuation doesn't vanish.

elis: colorblind sim: primary/secondary overlap becomes muddy for deutan. suggested series: primary #2cc3ff, secondary #ffb26a, tertiary #b78df2. also add patterned fill fallback for exported grayscale reports.

serena: small copy nit: change toggle label to be explicit. i18n key: theme.selector_label -> 'Theme preference: System / Light / Dark'. include aria-label: 'Theme preference; follows OS when System selected'.

design-bot: branch created: feat/nocturne-tokens. deploy preview: https://deploy.preview/redwood-console/feat/nocturne (expires in 48h). automated axe: 3 warnings, 1 violation (legend dot contrast). details posted to PR.

jay: i'll run contrast checks and post before/after screenshots here. also will test halo vs 2px stroke on retina and non-retina.

mike: tested inline weight 500 at 13px, line-height unaffected. posting screenshots for caret #aef6ff.

elis: i'll update figma swatches and include a colorblind-safe variant and pattern samples for prints.

serena: thanks all. plan: land tokens + copy + legend halo this sprint if contrast fix is green. thumbs by EOD please. :rocket:
